seoTitle: Family Guy Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Family Guy test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Peter, Lois, Meg, Chris, Stewie, Brian, Quagmire, Cleveland or Joe — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the impulsive dad, the evil-genius baby, or the dog who thinks he's the smartest one in the house? Answer 12 everyday questions about family, friends and bad ideas, and find out which Family Guy character you are.

characters.name: Peter Griffin
characters.title: The Wild Card
characters.summary: Fun, fearless and completely impulsive. You do whatever pops into your head, and somehow life is never boring.
description: Like Peter, you live in the moment. He's the boisterous, impulsive head of the Griffin family.
You never think things through. Peter's ridiculous antics drive most of the show's chaos.
You've got a job, technically. Peter works at the Pawtucket Brewery.
characters.flaw: You act first, and you don't think about it afterwards either.
characters.signature: A big laugh, a terrible idea and absolutely no plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd drag you into a ridiculous scheme, then blame you for it

characters.name: Lois Griffin
characters.title: The Voice of Reason
characters.summary: Smart, patient and tougher than you look. You hold everything together, until you finally snap.
description: Like Lois, you're the voice of reason. She's the sharp-witted mum of the Griffin family.
You've got hidden talents. Lois is a former piano teacher, and she has a black belt.
You've got a wild side. Lois can be volatile, and she's not always as sensible as she looks.
characters.flaw: You keep the peace for so long that you eventually explode.
characters.signature: A raised eyebrow, a piano and a very long list of chores.
characters.clashReason: they'd give you the look, and you'd know you were in trouble

characters.name: Meg Griffin
characters.title: The Underdog
characters.summary: Kind, resilient and hugely underrated. People don't always notice you, but you've got more going for you than they know.
description: Like Meg, you know what it's like to feel overlooked. She's the eldest Griffin kid, and her family often treats her badly.
You're a bit awkward, and that's fine. Meg is socially awkward and insecure at school.
You're more talented than people realise. Meg occasionally shows real confidence and talent.
characters.flaw: You wait for people to notice you, instead of making them.
characters.signature: A hopeful smile, a quiet sigh and a whole lot of untapped potential.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you, at length, how unfair everything is

characters.name: Chris Griffin
characters.title: The Sweetheart
characters.summary: Friendly, laid-back and easy to please. You don't sweat the small stuff, and you're nicer than almost anyone.
description: Like Chris, you're friendly and laid-back. He's the Griffins' teenage son.
You're a chip off the old block. Chris looks a lot like a younger Peter.
You're smarter than people think. Chris sometimes shows more potential than anyone expects.
characters.flaw: You get distracted by the smallest things.
characters.signature: A big smile, a snack and not a care in the world.
characters.clashReason: they'd forget what you were talking about halfway through

characters.name: Stewie Griffin
characters.title: The Mastermind
characters.summary: Brilliant, ambitious and very sharp-tongued. You've always got a scheme on the go, and you're usually the smartest one in the room.
description: Like Stewie, you've always got a plan. He's the Griffins' baby, with a British accent and very grown-up manners.
You think big. Stewie started out plotting world domination.
You're an inventor. Stewie builds his own gadgets, and even travels through time.
characters.flaw: You'd rather scheme than just ask nicely.
characters.signature: A gadget, a clever plan and a very sharp tongue.
characters.clashReason: they'd outsmart you, then mock you for it

characters.name: Brian Griffin
characters.title: The Intellectual
characters.summary: Smart, cultured and full of opinions. You love a good book and a good argument, and you're not shy about sharing either.
description: Like Brian, you're cultured. He's the family dog, and he loves a martini.
You've got big creative dreams. Brian is an aspiring writer who went to Brown University.
You've got opinions, lots of them. Brian is sardonic, and never shy about saying what he thinks.
characters.flaw: You can be a bit of a know-it-all.
characters.signature: A martini, a half-finished novel and an opinion on everything.
characters.clashReason: they'd correct your grammar, then quote a book about it

characters.name: Quagmire
characters.title: The Charmer
characters.summary: Confident, charming and always up for adventure. You love to travel, and you never miss a chance to flirt.
description: Like Quagmire, you're confident and smooth. He's the Griffins' next-door neighbour, and one of Peter's friends.
You love to travel. Quagmire is an airline pilot, and a former Navy man.
You're a famous charmer. Quagmire is known for his flirting, and his catchphrases.
characters.flaw: You flirt first and think later.
characters.signature: A pilot's uniform, a cheeky wink and a catchphrase ready to go.
characters.clashReason: they'd flirt with everyone you know

characters.name: Cleveland Brown
characters.title: The Gentleman
characters.summary: Polite, calm and kind. You're the easiest person to be around, and you never make a fuss.
description: Like Cleveland, you're polite and gentle. He's one of Peter's friends.
You've had a few careers. Cleveland owned a deli, and later becomes a mailman.
You're a star in your own right. Cleveland even gets his own spin-off, The Cleveland Show.
characters.flaw: You're so polite that you never say what you really think.
characters.signature: A gentle smile, a friendly wave and very good manners.
characters.clashReason: they'd be so polite that you'd never know what they really thought

characters.name: Joe Swanson
characters.title: The Tough Guy
characters.summary: Tough, determined and honest. You never give up, and you always do things by the book.
description: Like Joe, you're tough. He's a police officer in the Quahog Police Department.
Nothing stops you. Joe uses a wheelchair, and he's still one of the most skilled officers on the force.
You play it by the book. Joe will even arrest his own friends if they break the law.
characters.flaw: You're a little too competitive, about everything.
characters.signature: A badge, a loud voice and a never-give-up attitude.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn everything into a competition, and win

questions.text: You get a sudden urge to do something completely ridiculous. You...

options.text: Do it, immediately, without thinking
Talk yourself out of it, then secretly wish you hadn't
Let someone else go first, and watch
Plan it carefully first, with diagrams

questions.text: You're new at a party, and you don't know anyone. You...

options.text: Introduce yourself to everyone, with a wink
Hover near the door, hoping someone talks to you
Find the smartest person there, and start a debate
Wander around happily, making friends with the dog
TV, snacks and a very long nap
A good novel, and a martini in hand
Working on your latest invention
A long workout, then a barbecue

questions.text: Someone breaks the rules right in front of you. You...

options.text: Deal with it on the spot. Rules are rules, even for friends
Give them a look that stops them cold
Shrug. Rules are more like suggestions
Tell them off, then immediately regret it

questions.text: A friend asks for your honest opinion on something they made. You...

options.text: Give a long, slightly smug critique
Tear it apart, wittily
Say something kind, and very gentle
Say it's great, and really mean it

questions.text: You lose a friendly competition. You...

options.text: Demand a rematch. Right now
Throw a tantrum, then forget all about it
Congratulate the winner, warmly, and mean it
Assume nobody noticed you were there anyway

questions.text: You're asked to write a speech for a big occasion. You...

options.text: Spend weeks on it, and tell everyone you're working on something important
Make it up on the spot
Write something brilliant and slightly evil
Keep it short and sweet. Nobody likes a long speech

questions.text: Your family embarrasses you in public. You...

options.text: Wish the ground would swallow you up
Don't notice. You were probably part of it
Apologise to everyone, then lose it at home
Pretend you've never met them

questions.text: A friend asks you to help them move house. You...

options.text: Turn up first, and work the hardest
Help, and bring snacks for everyone
Say yes, then spend the day chatting up the neighbours
Turn up, break something valuable, then leave

questions.text: You get some unexpected money. You...

options.text: Spend it all on something ridiculous, today
Put it away for the family
Book a trip somewhere with a beach
Lose it within the hour

questions.text: You find out you can build a time machine. You...

options.text: Build one this afternoon. Obviously
Meet all the great writers, and impress them
Go back and redo every awkward moment of your life
Relive your favourite dinner, again and again

questions.text: You're a police officer, and you catch your best friend breaking the law. You...

options.text: Arrest them. A crime's a crime
Let them off with a polite warning
Look the other way, and buy them a drink later
Make them turn themselves in
